progress.colourRule: ring colour by match %: >=90 #5eead4 (mint), >=80 #22d3ee, >=65 #3b82f6, else #6366f1 — solid stroke, NOT a gradient

scanning.when: from mount until the ring starts to fill (0-1.8 s after the screen appears): '0%' for 0.9 s, then random 1..99 digits for 0.9 s (see still/result-mid.webp)

match.when: from 1.8 s after mount: count-up 0->98 over 1.8 s, label flips to MATCH, number turns to the brand gradient

label.tailwind: mt-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground

animation.mount: screen enters with opacity 0→1, scale 0.94→1, y 32→0 over 0.4 s [0.16,1,0.3,1]; content column y 40→0 over 0.5 s
animation.ringWrapper: scale 0→1 spring, delay 0.2 s, stiffness 180, damping 22

timeline.what: scanning: number flickers random 1..99 and label reads 'scanning...' (muted grey, no gradient)
slot-machine phase starts (900 ms of random numbers, slowing after 70%)
ring + count-up start together: 'match' label appears, number turns to the brand gradient, halo + pulse ring start

animation.badgeOnProductImage: '98% match' badge pops in (spring 280/18) when scanning ends and counts with the number — static 98 % in the plate

hidden: the whole ring wrapper (track + progress circle + pulse ring + halo + percentage number + 'MATCH' label)
plate.identicalToResult: taken from the same frozen frame as still/result.webp, so everything else (background glow, stars, product card incl. its static '98% match' badge, chips, e-mail row, button) is pixel-identical
plate.note: the vector ring should be drawn at layout.result.ring.centre with radiusCss / strokeWidthCss

midStill.note: ring fully in, label 'SCANNING...', slot-machine digits running
